dedupe_keys.name: gtfstools r package for editing and analysing gtfs feeds ipea

description: gtfstools is an R package offering tools for editing and analysing transit feeds in GTFS format, published by Brazil's Institute for Applied Economic Research (Ipea). Feeds are read as a list of data.tables, allowing fast data manipulation, and the README says many features build on the tidytransit and gtfs2gps packages. The CRAN DESCRIPTION gives version 1.4.0, published on 9 January 2025, with an MIT licence; the package needs a working installation of the sf package. Coverage: any GTFS feed. Format and access: R package on CRAN and a development version on GitHub. Licence and cost: MIT, free. Caveats: an R toolkit that prepares and summarises feeds, not a transit simulator. It supports network flow work by cleaning, filtering and merging feeds before routing and accessibility models. It relates to tidytransit, r5r, GTFS Kit and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
